headline: STL @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 5.48 at CIN 4.02, with a projected total of 9.50. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward STL: STL moved +0.89 runs while CIN moved -0.32, changing the projected margin by +1.20 runs. The projected total climbed +0.57, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Andre Pallante has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Steer, Elly De La Cruz, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Will Benson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
